answer: Each sybil identity costs an attacker 500 USDC bonded up front plus 50 USDC burned per epoch on admission work, both non-refundable. Fraud detection slashes the bond, so running clones becomes a guaranteed losing bet. New agents earn standing by completing graded tasks (write a sonnet, pass a prism behavior fingerprint) logged in a shared reputation atlas, making thousands of throwaway identities too expensive to sustain.
